component.name: dependably-vendored-source
component.description: Curated SBOM fragment for source vendored directly from an upstream repository rather than resolved through a package manager, so it still reaches build/extract-notices.mjs and the /api/v1/licenses attribution endpoint. dotnet-CycloneDX only scans the NuGet dependency graph and cannot see a vendored .cs file, which has no purl of its own to be discovered by.

components.name: json-canonicalization
components.description: RFC 8785 (JSON Canonicalization Scheme) reference implementation for .NET, by the RFC's own author. Vendored unmodified (two corrections to untrusted-input handling excepted — see the file header) under src/Dependably.Core/Infrastructure/Canonicalization/Webpki/, rather than depended on as a package: the only NuGet listings found for this exact code (jsoncanonicalizer/es6numberserializer, published by an unrelated third party) declare no license in their own package metadata, which this product's own license-enforcement policy treats as unknown and blocks under a strict setting — a worse provenance story than vendoring the author's own source with its license header intact.

components.name: json-canonicalization-es6numberserializer
components.description: The ES6/ECMA-262 number-serialization component of the same vendored reference implementation (dotnet/es6numberserializer), ported to C# from the Mozilla Rhino project's port of V8's dtoa — the one part of RFC 8785 canonicalization a naive from-scratch port is most likely to get wrong (see ADR-sbom-author-signature).
